records.text: An anonymous Turning Point USA board member said Charlie and Erika Kirk's estate planning made clear that Erika would be responsible for the organization if anything happened to Charlie.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 1QZ4X6q1DPg)

appearances.snippet: One board member who wished to remain anonymous confirmed to the Daily Mail that he was personally involved with the personal financial and estate planning with the couple after they were married. ... And during those discussions, they made clear that if anything should happen to Kirk, his wife would be responsible for the organization that he had.

verification.notes: The Daily Mail article directly reports that an anonymous board member involved in the couple personal, financial, and estate planning said Erika would be responsible for the organization if anything happened to Charlie. This verifies that the board member made the reported statement; it does not independently establish private planning documents.

sources.title: Daily Mail: Charlie Kirk appoints wife Erika Kirk as CEO
sources.relevance: Direct article contains the anonymous board member estate-planning statement.

records.text: The anonymous board member said the Turning Point USA board already knew Charlie Kirk's succession plan because board members had discussed it with him.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 1QZ4X6q1DPg)

appearances.snippet: The board already knew that the plan, what the plan was, because they talked about it with Charlie (Charlie Kirk).

verification.notes: The Daily Mail article directly quotes the anonymous board member saying the board already knew the plan because members had discussed it with Charlie and that everybody knew. This verifies the attributed statement, while the source remains anonymous.
